i_about_text_1: Graduated in Computer Engineering from the University of Santiago de Compostela and currently in the final phase of the Master's in Big Data at the same university, I am about to complete my academic training with the presentation of my Master's Thesis. Throughout these years, I have developed a solid technical foundation in programming, data analysis, and artificial intelligence, combined with a growing passion for scientific research applied to real-world problems.
i_about_text_2: My professional goal is to steer my career towards research through a PhD in Information Technology. I am particularly passionate about natural language processing applied to social media, an area where my interests in massive data, artificial intelligence, and the social impact of technology converge.
i_contact_text: Feel free to reach out to me through any of the following platforms or send me a message directly. I'm always open to discussing new opportunities, projects, or just having a chat about technology.
